feedback.title: Analyst feedback
feedback.intro: What a real platform can measure: what analysts confirmed on alerts and what the control sample, drawn from below the cutoff, found outside the queue. Only reporting and archiving as a confirmed false positive count as feedback.

cells.outsideNone: control sample off or not drawn yet

feedback.weeklyEmpty: No conclusive decisions on queue alerts yet.
feedback.simulatedNote: {count} labels come from the demo's simulated analyst, which decides by the ground truth: the numbers above are not from real analysts.
feedback.retrainSimulated: available only including simulated feedback (Settings > Model).
